limitations: No browser automation/DOM/click/form/authenticated web session/JavaScript execution/Active Web.
No implicit SearXNG instance or credentials. Endpoint must support JSON; host opt-in required. AVAILABLE is not a real-provider quality/uptime claim.
Remote document forwarding remains false and independent of web search.
Remote PDF/DOCX binary MIME support is not expanded beyond S5 textual policy.
Only explicit URL refresh; snapshots can become stale. No auto-fetch of search result pages/cache/polling.
Search results are ToolResult data, not automatically indexed/persisted Source or MEMORY. Canonical transcript may retain ToolResults under Core.
No real LLM/provider/semantic quality campaign in K6; K8 remains separate.
No universal DLP/secret detection/ciphering/sandbox/process isolation/secure erase.
K7 interface UX/source details/delegation/hardening not implemented.
